title: Data & usage: your plan, usage and Export all data
summary: See how much of RetailOps your store uses, your plan's limits, and download everything your store keeps.

blocks.text: Setup › **Data & usage** shows what your store uses and lets an owner or admin download all of the store's data. Staff do not see this page.

items: **Users**, **Items** and **File storage** are measured each night.
**Sales synced**, **POS requests** and **AI requests** add up over the last 30 days.
**Last activity** is the last time someone at the store used RetailOps.

blocks.text: Your plan sets how many users, items and how much file storage are included. From 80% of a limit the bar turns amber (near the limit); above it, red (over the limit). A limit never stops your store's work.

items: Press **Export all data**. Making the file takes a minute or two for most stores.
When it shows **Ready**, press **Download**. The Download link works for a limited time.
Open the ZIP: **tables/** has one spreadsheet (CSV) per table, **files/** every stored file, and **manifest.json** a checksum for each file.

blocks.text: Passwords, sign-in tokens, push tokens and saved keys are never in a data export. A data export is kept for 7 days; make a new one any time.
If an export fails, press **Try again**. One export runs at a time per store.
